blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The widow and schoolmates of 1st Lt. Angeleo Adrian Peñaflor, a Philippine Air Force (PAF) pilot who died in a training flight, hailed him as a hero. “When you take away my greatest love, you might as well take my soul with you,” Bernadette, the pilot’s widow, wrote in a social media post on Saturday, October 24. “They say it’s all part and parcel of the job. But no one ever prepares you for the pain of losing the person who means the world to you,” she added. READ ALSO: 4 PAF pilots killed in Batangas […]...
